A0161.title: On-Chain Data Access Control
A0161.definition: Implementing encryption and access control mechanisms for sensitive data to restrict unauthorized read access.
A0161.description: Data protection: store sensitive data off-chain; only store hashes on-chain; encrypt before uploading to the chain; enforce access control lists; apply proxy re-encryption; use threshold decryption.
A0161.limitation: Reduces on-chain transparency, introduces complex key management, and incurs significant performance overhead. If proxy re-encryption or threshold decryption keys are stolen or leaked via side-channel attacks, an attacker can bypass the access control list and decrypt on-chain data. Overly restrictive permissions may also mistakenly block legitimate users from normal data reads.
